notes: Rebuilt from the client's own skill table (GWToolbox dump, scripts/import_skilldump.py) after the first pass had been transcribed by hand from the wiki notes and missed roughly two thirds of the update: every new PvP split, and the reworks the notes worded as prose rather than as a number (Primal Rage, Decapitate, Lightning Strike, Illusionary Weaponry, Blackout, Ethereal Burden). Hand-written entries were kept wherever the two disagreed, since those carry the genuine pre-update value and the dump can only speak for the present. That happened exactly once, on Symbols of Inspiration (1339): the notes recorded a recharge of 15 -> 10, the client still says 15, so the entry now reverts to the value already in force and is a no-op. Descriptions are reverted because LoadPatches re-runs ParseScalesFromDescription over them, so a pre-update replay has to read the pre-update numbers to deduce attributes. `concise` is deliberately not reverted: nothing renders it, and it is only ever read as a scale source for a skill whose description is empty, which no player skill is. See scripts/check_skillpatches.py. The 32 skills the update split for PvP also revert pvp_split/split_id: Get and GetView follow that link to answer as the PvP half, so without it a replay from before the split renders PvP numbers for a skill that had no PvP version at the time.
